settings.aggregation: mean over coordinates of normalized squared error of x^2; median over chains of the error curve, then first crossing
settings.production_horizon: min(floor(3 n_base), 500000), extended to min(floor(5 n_base), 500000) if the median curve has not crossed
settings.baseline: BlackJAX MCLMC tuning (phased adapter), tuning length chosen per problem; EEVPD 5e-4
settings.production_state: random unit momentum from the evaluator key, 1 gradient evaluation to build; 2 evaluations per transition
settings.seed_schedule: key = fold_in(key(seed), crc32(problem name)); split into init, burn-in and production keys; chain keys by split

development: independent until all candidates are frozen
